reserveReview.rationale: Moneta's current transparency display reports an 80% money-market-fund allocation and 20% USD bank deposits. Its reserve policy identifies institutional money-market funds and short-duration Treasury exposure, while NBX identifies the named managers and banking counterparties used across the separately maintained issuer pools.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer does not publish position-level fund holdings, bank balances, or the split between the separately maintained Moneta and NBX reserve pools.
